To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ringgit-yen exchange rate has a positive effect on trade flows in Malaysia.
exchange-rate variability is a significant factor in the short run for the majority of export and import industries between Malaysia and Japan.
exchange-rate risk is an important determinant in bilateral trade flows between Malaysia-Japan, especially for the manufacturing industry.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the exchange-rate risk effect on trade flows between Malaysia–Japan.
the exchange-rate risk and its implications for the trade flows between two major trading countries.
the exchange-rate risk effect on bilateral trade between Japan and Malaysia, which has been largely overlooked in the literature.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
exchange-rate risk is not a significant determinant of trade flows in Malaysia.
the exchange-rate variability effect on Malaysian trade flows with Japan is mixed and industry-specific.
the exchange-rate variability effect in Malaysian bilateral trade flows is not as severe as perceived by the literature, but the effect is still there.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ringgit/yen exchange-rate risk has a positive effect on bilateral trade flows between Malaysia–Japan.
exchange-rate risk sensitivity is a major determinant of industry trade flows between the two countries.
the exchange rate variability effect is more pronounced in the export industries.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ringgit/yem variability has a significant impact on trade flows between Malaysia-Japan.
exchange-rate variability has a significant impact on trade flows in a number of industries.
exchange-rate variability has a mixed effect on trade between Malaysia and Japan, which is in contrast with the findings of the previous studies.
